name: Sedition
overview: Scripture reveals sedition as a serious charge associated with stirring unrest and rebellion, as seen in the accusations against Paul, who was labeled a 'mover of sedition' and a ringleader of the Nazarenes (Acts 24:5). Historical examples like Theudas and Judas of Galilee illustrate how those who incited people to follow them were ultimately defeated and scattered (Acts 5:36-37). These passages emphasize the consequences of leading others into rebellion against established order, demonstrating God's sovereignty over such disturbances.
